description: Allowlist for the dependency supply-chain audit gate (issue #178) and the frontend-bundle secret scan gate (issue #181). Entries here are packages that do NOT yet publish provenance/attestation metadata. They are treated as an accepted, non-blocking gap: the CI gate reports them for visibility and tracks provenance coverage as a baseline to improve over time. Do NOT add entries to silence real signature verification failures.

provenanceGaps.reason: Publisher does not yet support npm provenance attestation; tracked as an accepted gap.

baseline.note: Baseline provenance-coverage percentage. Update this value as more dependencies publish attestations. The CI gate fails only on signature verification errors, not on missing provenance.

bundleSecretScan.description: Tuning for the secrets-in-frontend-bundle scan (issue #181). The scan runs gitleaks against the production build output (.next) rather than the repo, since anything shipped to the client bundle is inherently public. Entries below are known-safe public values that match a secret pattern but are intentionally public (e.g. public Testnet contract IDs, well-known public API endpoints). Do NOT add entries to silence genuine secrets — only add values that are provably public and non-sensitive.

allowlist.description: Public Stellar Testnet contract IDs are intentionally public and may match generic hex/secret-like patterns.
Public Stellar network passphrases (Testnet/Public) are documented, non-sensitive constants.
